verdict.rationale: The ssh kitten is explicitly documented to automatically set up shell integration, forward terminfo, transfer config, and reuse connections when SSHing to remote hosts, directly matching the story. Community reports mostly note a related manual workaround (TERM=xterm-kitty issues) rather than contradicting the kitten's own automatic integration feature. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the ssh kitten (not just remote-control) and broader real-world confirmation across shells/OSes.
